composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_4 is using a fine dental pick and pin-tool to meticulously clear away smooth, cream white fine-grained Solnhofen limestone matrix in a museum preparation lab. A perfectly preserved, articulated Archaeopteryx fossil skeleton is revealed, showcasing delicate impressions of wing and tail feathers. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
